$description: BRAND-UNIQUE tokens — values that exist only for this specific brand and don't fit into universal core/semantic/component layers. Examples: pillar colors (Relaxia 3-pillar), signature accent (gold for a luxury brand), proprietary methodology colors. Per DR-029 + Bible Part 31.

pillar-colors.$description: Brand-specific pillar/category colors — example for Relaxia 3-pillar architecture. Replace per brand structure.

pillar-1.$description: e.g., Calm by Design — soft blue-grey for tranquility

pillar-2.$description: e.g., Smaller by Technology — tech-modern accent

pillar-3.$description: e.g., Sleep when Needed — deep premium tone

signature-accent.$description: Brand signature highlight color — used sparingly for hero CTAs, awards, proprietary IP markers

methodology-tokens.$description: Visual tokens tied to proprietary methodologies — e.g., MID workflow phase colors, EYWA Compound Growth chart colors

_usage_notes: Brand tokens override semantic tokens when brand-specific visual identity calls for it
Pillar colors should reference each other consistently (e.g., gradient between pillars in hero visuals)
Signature accent should be used <5% of visual surface — its power is in scarcity
Methodology tokens map to brand's proprietary frameworks — e.g., MID Workflow 5 phases need 5 progressively-stepped colors
